name: Financial Instrument 21
definition: Security that is a sub-set of an investment fund, and is governed by the same investment fund policy, for example, dividend option or valuation currency.

ClassType.name: Class Type
ClassType.definition: Features of units offered by a fund. For example, a unit may have a specific load structure, for example, front end or back end, an income policy, eg, pay out or accumulate, or a trailer policy, eg, with or without. Fund classes are typically denoted by a single character, for example, 'Class A', 'Class 2'.

SecuritiesForm.name: Securities Form
SecuritiesForm.definition: Specifies the form, that is, ownership, of the security.

DistributionPolicy.name: Distribution Policy
DistributionPolicy.definition: Income policy relating to a class type, that is, if income is paid out or retained in the fund.

ProductGroup.name: Product Group
ProductGroup.definition: Company specific description of a group of funds.

UmbrellaName.name: Umbrella Name
UmbrellaName.definition: Name of the umbrella fund in which financial instrument is contained.

BaseCurrency.name: Base Currency
BaseCurrency.definition: Currency of the investment fund class.

DenominationCurrency.name: Denomination Currency
DenominationCurrency.definition: Currency in which a security is issued or redenominated.

RequestedNAVCurrency.name: Requested NAV Currency
RequestedNAVCurrency.definition: Currency to be used for pricing the fund. This currency must be among the set of currencies in which the price may be expressed, as stated in the prospectus.

DualFundIndicator.name: Dual Fund Indicator
DualFundIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the fund has two prices.

CountryOfDomicile.name: Country Of Domicile
CountryOfDomicile.definition: Country where the fund has legal domicile as reflected in the ISIN classification.

RegisteredDistributionCountry.name: Registered Distribution Country
RegisteredDistributionCountry.definition: Countries where the fund is registered for distribution.
